title: The affected products insufficiently restrict runtime-supplied visualization data, allowing local program execution on…
description: A vulnerability in certain CODESYS Control runtime products allows insufficient restriction of runtime-supplied visualization data, enabling local code execution on the engineering workstation. This occurs if a user is logged into a CODESYS Control runtime and operates a visualization. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this by controlling a malicious runtime or performing a man-in-the-middle attack to execute arbitrary code on the engineering workstation.
